DocUpquick start

How to scan and upload your supplier documents and card receipts, in a few taps.

About 3 minutes
Admin
Checking
Accounts
Historical

You're all setto add documents

  • Scan supplier documents in the app: Scan Documents › Supplier Delivery Docs.
  • Upload files from a computer: Upload Supplier Delivery, Invoices, Statements, Other.
  • Card receipts: pick your card (e.g. Visa Debit) when scanning, or use Upload receipts under the card.
  • Add documents as they arrive. Synergy Up takes it from there.
